title: Like & Unlike Terms
blurb: Which sums collapse into one term and which stay open. Conjoining — forcing 2+3x into 5x — is the classic closure error.

title: The Minus Sign
blurb: One notation, two distinct roles: subtraction and negation. (A minus before a bracket is negation, which by -1x = -x you may read as multiply-by-(-1) - a theorem, not a third role.) The single highest-priority group.

title: The Five Basic Forms
blurb: Recognition in unambiguous cases. Foundation before the misleading forms.

title: Misleading Surface Forms
blurb: Where a visible operation distracts from the dominant one. The core of Skill 2.
